title: The Knight of Malta
author: Eugène Sue

authorInfo.bio: Eugène Sue (1804–1857) wrote The Wandering Jew — Complete. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.

description: "The Knight of Malta" by Eugène Sue is a historical novel likely written in the mid-19th century. The narrative is set against the backdrop of Provence, showcasing a time when the coastal regions were plagued by Algerian pirates, creating a sense of urgency and peril.
